headline: Pakistan Government Cuts Petrol and Diesel Prices
summary: The Pakistan government decreased the price of petrol by Re1 to Rs313 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs2 to Rs346 per litre.
why: Regulated retail fuel price adjustments directly influence domestic transportation costs and consumer inflation metrics in Pakistan.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Lower retail fuel prices reduce immediate energy expenses for consumers and commercial transport.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
